Each content vector reads only waveform[begin:begin+3200] through energy, normalization and STFT. Changing all other disjoint slices cannot alter that content. The recorded support includes the full slice because energy/normalization read all its original samples, including tail samples not covered by a complete STFT frame.
At event anchor1300, content uses original samples from1200 through before1400; this includes samples after1300. Thus block-local and fixed sequence order do not imply sample-by-sample causality.

The feature z_i=(local_i,mean(all samples)) mixes full-recording context yet retains local_i and time_i. A time query can read local_i and ignore the context coordinate. Therefore strict raw-support locality is sufficient for this lesson's invariance contract, but is not necessary for all time-specific judgments. This logical counterexample makes no statistical-quality claim.
